answer: Bind each identity to one hardware secure enclave: the chip signs a fresh attestation proving it is a distinct physical device, and one chip can back only one vertex in the identity graph. A hollow shell with no chip cannot pass, and a sybil farmer must buy a real chip per fake, so the cost flows like a river — linear in the number of clones. Limit: it excludes software-only agents, and trust shifts to chip makers, who could over-issue or be compromised.
